chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn 'Uthman, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked him about the woman when she dies, so he said: "Her husband inserts his hand beneath her shirt up to the elbows, then he performs her ghusl."

key_terms.الْمَرَافِقِ: the elbows; the limit mentioned for the hand
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.زَوْجُهَا: her husband, who is permitted to perform the washing
key_terms.فَيُغَسِّلُهَا: then he performs her ghusl, meaning he washes her body ritually after death
key_terms.قَمِيصِهَا: her shirt or garment, under which the hand is inserted
key_terms.مَاتَتْ: she died; the state that triggers the funeral ruling

ai.seo_question: Can a husband perform the ghusl of his deceased wife in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the ghusl of a deceased woman by her husband. It indicates that the husband may wash her body while keeping her covered, placing his hand beneath her garment up to the elbows.
